verdict.rationale: A government agency running online tax registration and wage-reporting services could plausibly publish a developer API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples. Every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returned 404, and the documented services (UTR, UTS, QuickFile) are web applications and file-upload tools, not a documented API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
